name: net_forced_resync_first_activation
description: Distinct living-only first-activation candidate in12/0B btl1. Preserve the original pre-movement death baseline and require it to be zero; execute ONLY the first three native900ms forward pulses, exactly one per peer, then stop movement and retain the4s settle. Saved attempt03 host frames6130/6190/6250 showed four309 all160HP before later311 append and tombstones for positive-HP309 netIds1/2; that prior54-step fixture failed correctly before resync and remains unchanged. This candidate must freshly establish exactly four309 with unique positive bindings, two matching native hash samples and two independent exact actor/type/HP census joins, with no death-log changes. Host-only damage7 must lower every original current binding by exactly7 while all remain alive, then another complete census must still match. ONE all-target forced resync must prove both original target identities, genuine native reload/full-progress/two-frame convergence and matching relay+host-runtime terminal evidence; fresh post-resync hashes and independent censuses must preserve exact damaged host IDs/types/HP/progress without extras or unmatched/refilled substitutions. Capture all three renders only after strict checks; pixels do not prove identity/HP. The historical first-activation window is not proof it remains stable after stopping or reload; failure remains failure. No second-pack, dead-history, barrier, remote-machine, native creation-incarnation or nonzero progress-write acceptance; no transforms, kills, baseline reset or expected-pass exception.

[log_count('host death', i) for i in range(3)]

steps.message: Original pre-movement baseline must contain zero host-death/tombstone observations; it is never moved or reset

len(enemy_hps(0)) > 0 and len(enemy_hps(1)) == len(enemy_hps(0)) and len(enemy_hps(2)) == len(enemy_hps(0))
